analysis.evidence: The plural verb agrees with הַמַּיִם, “the waters.” וַיִּגְבְּרוּ describes the waters gaining force, and the following וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד describes their great increase as the ark floated on their surface.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine plural, with prefixed וַ־.

draft.change: Mark Genesis 7:18–20 as defining evidence for the existing literal sense “a body or flow of water.”
draft.definition: A body or flow of water, here the floodwaters on which the ark floats.
draft.evidence: Genesis 7:18 identifies the rising waters by describing the ark moving on their surface.

analysis.evidence: The marked הַמַּיִם is the subject of both וַיִּגְבְּרוּ, “grew strong,” and וַיִּרְבּוּ, “increased.” The ark moves on the surface of these same waters, identifying them as the floodwaters spreading over the land.
analysis.morphology: Masculine plural noun in the absolute state, with prefixed definite article הַ־ and doubling of the initial מ.
analysis.sense: a body or flow of water

analysis.evidence: וַיִּרְבּוּ shares its subject הַמַּיִם (‘the waters’) with וַיִּגְבְּרוּ. The following מְאֹד (‘greatly’) marks the degree to which the waters increased.
analysis.morphology: Prefixed conjunction וַ־ followed by a Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine plural, agreeing with הַמַּיִם.

analysis.evidence: מְאֹד modifies וַיִּרְבּוּ in וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד, describing how much the waters increased: “they increased greatly.”
analysis.morphology: Adverb of degree, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: עַל governs הָאָרֶץ in עַל הָאָרֶץ, “over the earth,” specifying where the waters grew strong and increased.
עַל הָאָרֶץ describes where the floodwaters increased, “over the earth.” The next clause locates the ark more precisely עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם, “on the surface of the waters.”
analysis.morphology: Definite article הָ־ + common noun, singular absolute, common gender.

analysis.evidence: The feminine singular verb agrees with הַתֵּבָה, “the ark.” The phrase עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם describes where the ark moved, “on the surface of the water.”
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third-person feminine singular, with prefixed וַ־.
analysis.sense: go, move from place to place

draft.change: Add תֵּבָה under its own consonants תבה. The construction and movement of the vessel establish the sense in this verse.
draft.definition: An enclosed vessel that holds and protects its occupants on water. Here it is Noah’s ark.
draft.evidence: Genesis 6:14 directs Noah to build the תֵּבָה of wood and coat it with pitch inside and out. Genesis 7:17–18 describes the waters lifting it and the ark moving on their surface.

analysis.evidence: In וַתֵּלֶךְ הַתֵּבָה עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם, הַתֵּבָה is the subject of the feminine singular verb וַתֵּלֶךְ. The ark moves on the surface of the water after the rising waters lift it in Genesis 7:17.
analysis.morphology: Definite article הַ־ prefixed to a feminine singular absolute common noun.
analysis.sense: The vessel that carried Noah, his family, and the animals on the floodwaters.

analysis.evidence: In וַתֵּלֶךְ הַתֵּבָה עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם, עַל introduces פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם, “the surface of the waters,” specifying where the ark moved.
In עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם, the ark moves on the surface of the waters. The construct form פְּנֵי names the surface, and הַמָּיִם specifies whose surface it is.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, both genders, plural construct, with no prefix or suffix.
